pedido: Short: "What Actually Happens If You Step in Quicksand?" Myth-busting: you do not sink like in movies (quicksand is denser than your body, you float waist-deep). The real danger is getting stuck, the tide coming in, dehydration and exhaustion. Show how to escape: lean back, spread out, wiggle legs slowly. Hook: "Movies lied. Quicksand cannot swallow you, but it can still kill you."

videos.description:
Would you have panicked and pulled? 👇

What actually happens if you step in quicksand? Hollywood got it wrong, and here is how to survive.
Quicksand is about twice as dense as your body, so you float. The real danger is being stuck while the tide comes in.
